summary: DNSSEC signatures can use different algorithms. This document specifies how validating resolvers can signal to a server which digital signature and hash algorithms they support. This lets zone administrators learn when new algorithms are supported widely enough to start using them.

eli5.summary: A resolver tells a server which secret-code styles it understands, so the server knows when it is safe to switch to a newer style.

questions: how do dns resolvers signal supported dnssec algorithms
